newsitem.title: EGYPT: Samsung wins $207 mln contract in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Samsung wins $207 mln contract in Egypt.

text.p: Khalda Petroleum (KPC) has awarded Samsung Engineering a $207 million contract to develop gas fields in Egypt's Western Desert, Samsung Engineering said in a statement released on Monday.
The contract, for engineering, procurement and construction, was confirmed in a letter of intent from KPC and the delivery date for the project is May 1, 1999.
Later in 1999 gas fields in the Salam area of the Western Desert are expected to produce 300 million cubic feet a day.
KPC is a joint venture between the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC), Repsol Exploracion of Spain, Samsung Corporation of South Korea and Apache Corporation of the United States.
